bullet: Docker runtime mode without a daemon (`F12.docker-runtime-contract`).
script:
DK=$(control-agent-server launch --new --name f12-docker --env OH_CONVERSATION_RUNTIME=docker --env DOCKER_HOST=unix:///tmp/qa-f12-no-docker.sock --print-run)
trap 'control-agent-server stop --run "$DK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
control-agent-server api GET /server_info --run "$DK" --auth none --expect 200 --check conversation_runtime eq docker
Z=$(python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())')
U=$(python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())')
DOCKER_501='501: This operation is unavailable in Docker runtime mode'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/fork" --run "$DK" --json '{}' --expect 501 --check exception eq "$DOCKER_501" \
  --save F12.docker-runtime-contract/fork
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/switch_llm" --run "$DK" --json '{}' --expect 501 --check exception eq "$DOCKER_501"
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/switch_profile" --run "$DK" --json '{}' --expect 501 --check exception eq "$DOCKER_501"
control-agent-server api PUT "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/credential-bindings/CODEX_AUTH_JSON" --run "$DK" --json "{\"url\": \"$NEVER/cred\"}" \
  --expect 501 --check exception eq "$DOCKER_501" --save F12.docker-runtime-contract/credential-binding
control-agent-server api PUT "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/credential-bindings/GITHUB_TOKEN" --run "$DK" --json '{}' --expect 501
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f12-never --expect-max 0
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/run" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/runtime" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found' \
  --save F12.docker-runtime-contract/runtime-unknown
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/runtime/reprovision" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found'
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/runtime" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found' --save F12.docker-runtime-contract/release-unknown
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/runtime/credentials" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found' \
  --save F12.docker-runtime-contract/credentials-unknown
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/runtime" --run "$DK" --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Z/runtime/credentials" --run "$DK" --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/events/$Z" --run "$DK" --expect-close 1008 --duration 10
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/session/$Z" --run "$DK" --expect-close 1008 --duration 10
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --run "$DK" --expect 400 --check detail eq 'Invalid JSON body'
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --run "$DK" --json '[1]' --expect 422 --check detail eq 'Expected a JSON object'
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --run "$DK" --json '{"workspace": {"kind": "RemoteWorkspace", "host": "http://127.0.0.1:9"}}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail eq 'Docker conversations require a local workspace'
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --run "$DK" --json '{"conversation_id": "not-a-uuid"}' --expect 400 --check detail eq 'Invalid conversation_id'
control-agent-server state ls --run "$DK" 'home/.openhands/runtime-control/*.json' --expect-count 0
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --run "$DK" \
  --json "{\"conversation_id\": \"$U\", \"agent\": {\"llm\": {\"model\": \"openai/qa-stub\", \"api_key\": \"<redacted:api_key>\"}, \"tools\": []}}" \
  --expect 502 --check exception eq '502: Could not create conversation container' --save F12.docker-runtime-contract/create
control-agent-server state ls --run "$DK" "home/.openhands/runtime-control/${U//-/}.json" --expect-count 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$U/runtime" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found'
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$U/runtime/reprovision" --run "$DK" --expect 502 \
  --check exception eq '502: Could not start conversation container'
control-agent-server ws listen "/sockets/events/$U" --run "$DK" --expect-close 1011 --duration 10
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$U" --run "$DK" --expect 200 --save F12.docker-runtime-contract/delete
control-agent-server state ls --run "$DK" "home/.openhands/runtime-control/${U//-/}.json" --expect-count 0
control-agent-server api DELETE "<redacted:session-cookie>/$U" --run "$DK" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Conversation not found'
control-agent-server stop --run "$DK"
